findings.issue: זְרֵה is qal imperative 2ms and הָאֵשׁ is its object; «el fuego esparce» makes the fire the 3rd-person scatterer.
Qal perfect 3cp of קדש is a state (they are/became holy); «se santificaron» can be read as reflexive self-sanctifying.

notes: Di, Elazar hijo de Aarón el sacerdote, y alce los braseros desde entre la quema, and más allá match the tokens.
